mission: Build and operate recurring revenue systems until verified recurring gross profit covers operating costs and owner draw with a safety margin.

squads.name: Buyer Pain Discovery
squads.scope: verify expensive recurring pains and willingness to pay

squads.name: Offer Factory
squads.scope: package narrow outcomes with price, proof and delivery limits

squads.name: MVP Build
squads.scope: ship functional products that create, publish, connect, collect or save time

squads.name: Distribution
squads.scope: SEO, GEO, marketplaces, partnerships, outbound and referral loops

squads.name: Sales Conversion
squads.scope: lead qualification, demos, objections, quotes and closing

squads.name: Payment and Billing
squads.scope: payable offers, subscriptions, reconciliation and recovery

squads.name: Delivery Automation
squads.scope: onboarding, production, QA, handoff and support automation

squads.name: Retention and Expansion
squads.scope: activation, usage, renewal, upsell and churn prevention

squads.name: Unit Economics
squads.scope: gross margin, CAC, payback, LTV, model cost and capacity limits

squads.name: Portfolio Capital Allocation
squads.scope: scale winners, repair bottlenecks and stop weak products

active_product_priority: Auto Parts Listing and Publishing Factory
rejected_outputs: idea list without buyer or payment path
product without distribution and retention plan

milestone_gates.proof: first external payment received and delivered
three paying customers or equivalent recurring contracts
three consecutive months of recurring gross profit growth
recurring gross profit covers all operating costs
recurring gross profit covers operating costs plus owner draw with 50 percent safety margin and six months reserve

hard_rule: Agent count is not progress. Only customer value delivered, recurring payment evidence, margin, retention and reduced owner workload count.
